idPolicy.roomId: Exact case-sensitive registered PAN-NNN; office is not an accepted alias.
idPolicy.scenarioId: Fixed scenario identifier; select together with scenarioVersion.
idPolicy.occupationId: Original career-net-NNN occupation identifier; not a run identifier.

experienceId.uniqueScope: new ID for each start; retain for request retransmission and internal reset

idPolicy.sessionId: Frontend-generated ID retained during integrated play.
idPolicy.scenarioRunId: Unity-generated ID; new on full reset; preserve previous runs.
idPolicy.requestId: Frontend-generated per command; same ID and same payload on retransmission.
idPolicy.eventId: Unity-generated immutable event ID; backend unique key(sessionId,eventId).
idPolicy.sequence: Monotonically increasing within session; gaps may include other rooms/runs; never reset per experience.
idPolicy.launchSelection: Exact buildId+roomId+scenarioId+scenarioVersion allowlist; same scenario across several rooms never resolves by first ID match.
